name: Youth Civic Engagement Program
what_you_do: Learn how City departments work and how decisions get made. Teams build a project and present it to a mock City Council.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 15 to 20. 20 spots, first come first served.
deadline_text: 2026 session was July 7 to 9, 2026. Next dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up through City of Richmond program sign up. The course ID for 2026 is 00530586.
notes: Held at Minoru Centre for Active Living and Richmond City Hall. Next summer dates not posted when read.
